title: Buy Old Man Mountain Ponderosa Panniers, Get Jesse Jams For a Limited Time
content:
Old Man Mountain is teaming up with Jesse Jams to step up your bikesnacking game, starting with a trail classic, the PB&J. After all, bikepacking is 50% pedaling and 50% planning the next snack stop. While the classic PB&J is great, Old Man Mountain and Jesse Jams make it even better. The next 50 customers to purchase a pair of Ponderosa Panniers from Old Man Mountain will receive a backcountry PB&J kit.

How do Panniers Fit into This?

Old Man Mountain Ponderosa Panniers are built for rugged adventure, but they have a hidden feature: the framesheet on the outside of the pannier is designed to improve compression but it is also removable and can double as a clean, portable cutting board. It’s the perfect surface for prepping lunch on the trail, so you can skip looking for a flat rock that doesn’t look like a goat has peed on it too recently.

A Jam Built for The Trail

Jesse Jams solved the other half of the problem. Jam has always belonged on the trail. The glass jar never did. So Jesse Jams rebuilt it from scratch. Real, all-natural jam in a lightweight, resealable pouch, with 100g of carbs and 400mg of electrolytes packed in. Squeeze it straight when you need fuel mid-climb, or spread it on a PB&J once you’ve found somewhere to sit. Add in your favorite nut butter (we love Trail Butter) and some tortillas (more compact and packable than bread), and you’ve got the ultimate bikepacking PB&J kit.

The Tasty Bits

To help you fuel your next ride, each of the 50 kits includes:

  • Old Man Mountain Ponderosa Panniers
  • Jesse Jams Strawberry Jam with Electrolytes Pouch
  • Trail Butter Maple Syrup with Sea Salt Almond Cashew Butter

If you pick up a pair of Ponderosa Panniers, they’ll come stuffed with Jesse Jams. See more at Old Man Mountain.
